name: CO₂ scrubber failure (CDRA)
source: OSDR EDA (highest CO₂ measured on ISS 6,977 ppm ≈ 5.3 mmHg); OCHMO-TB-004 symptom thresholds
note: Cabin ppCO₂ on the vehicle rises from 1.9 to 5.3 mmHg over 90 samples. Symptoms (respiration, EtCO₂, heart rate, PVT) scale with cabin CO₂; Kerem responds twice as strongly. When ventilation is increased CO₂ falls to 2.0 and symptoms recede. Symptom magnitudes are assumptions.
